content: {"rule": "K-S2", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text treats the absence of explicit textual resolution of paternity as a reason to mark D6 vs C4 UNDERDETERMINED.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.", "rule_words": "That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
